recommendations.recommendation: Confess your sins openly to God, acknowledging your dependence on his grace.
recommendations.rationale: God knows the heart fully, and his grace heals what is confessed.
recommendations.argued_against: Pride and concealment of one's sins.

recommendations.recommendation: Seek rest in God, since the heart stays restless until it finds him.
recommendations.rationale: Human longing is satisfied only by the divine, not by created things.
recommendations.argued_against: Seeking lasting satisfaction in created things.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid giving in to lust and sensual appetite, which enslave the will.
recommendations.rationale: Indulgence of appetite binds the will and draws it away from God.
recommendations.argued_against: Indulgence of lust and bodily appetite.

recommendations.recommendation: Love God above all things and love your neighbor as yourself.
recommendations.rationale: This love is the summary of the divine commandments.
recommendations.argued_against: Loving created things in place of God.

recommendations.recommendation: Be humble and recognize that all good comes from God.
recommendations.rationale: Every good gift comes from God, so pride has no basis.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid vain curiosity and the desire for worldly praise and display.
recommendations.rationale: Such pursuits scatter the soul and distract it from God.
recommendations.argued_against: Vainglory, idle curiosity, and seeking the approval of others.

recommendations.recommendation: Reflect on your memory and past life to recognize God's guidance in it.
recommendations.rationale: Looking back on one's life reveals the working of divine grace.

recommendations.recommendation: Pray and receive the sacraments as channels of God's grace.
recommendations.rationale: Prayer and the sacraments open the soul to God's help.
